engine_settings.chIntro: One yacht, sixteen guests of your choosing, and an itinerary shaped around your group within the protected waters of the Galápagos. From USD 199,500 per week. Our team responds to every charter enquiry within 24 hours.
engine_settings.chThanks: Thank you — your charter enquiry has been received. A dedicated member of our team will contact you within 24 hours to schedule a discovery call.

itineraries.desc: Isabela and Fernandina — the wild western edge. Flightless cormorants, marine iguana colonies, volcanic shorelines that feel newly made.
itineraries.long: This itinerary follows the Western Realm route. Isabela and Fernandina — the wild western edge. Flightless cormorants, marine iguana colonies, volcanic shorelines that feel newly made. Every day is led by our expert naturalist guides aboard an intimate 16-guest expedition yacht — snorkel, kayak, guided walks and wildlife observation included.

plan: Day 1 — Sunday
Embark in San Cristóbal (SCY). Welcome aboard, safety briefing, sunset sail.
Day 2
Punta Moreno & Elizabeth Bay, Isabela — zodiac through mangroves, penguins and rays.
Day 3
Urbina Bay & Tagus Cove, Isabela — giant tortoises, kayak the dramatic coastline.
Day 4
Punta Espinoza, Fernandina — snorkel with flightless cormorants and marine iguanas.
Day 5
Punta Vicente Roca — deep-water snorkel; whale-watching across the Bolívar Channel.
Day 6
Rábida & Chinese Hat — red-sand beaches, sea lion colonies, evening naturalist talk.
Day 7
Santa Cruz highlands — giant tortoises in the wild; farewell dinner aboard.
Day 8 — Sunday
Disembark in San Cristóbal after breakfast. Transfer to SCY airport.

Day 2
Genovesa — Prince Philip's Steps: red-footed boobies, Nazca boobies, short-eared owls.

Genovesa — Darwin Bay; snorkel walls alive with rays and reef fish.
Day 4
Bartolomé — Pinnacle Rock, penguins; lava fields of Sullivan Bay.
Day 5
Santiago — Puerto Egas; fur seal grottos, tide pools at golden hour.
Day 6
North Seymour — frigatebird colonies in display; blue-footed boobies.
Day 7
Santa Cruz highlands — giant tortoises; farewell dinner aboard.
